items.item_text: Procedural content uses ordered steps where useful.

items.item_text: Pages avoid vague marketing copy that cannot be cited or summarized.

items.item_text: Content is not chopped into unnatural AI-bait fragments.

items.checklist_title: AI SEO, AEO, And GEO Checklist
items.item_text: Statistics include source, date, unit, and context.

items.checklist_title: AI SEO, AEO, And GEO Checklist

items.checklist_title: AI SEO, AEO, And GEO Checklist
items.item_text: Expert quotes include name, role, organization, and relevant credentials.

items.checklist_title: AI SEO, AEO, And GEO Checklist
items.item_text: Recommendations explain tradeoffs, not only conclusions.

items.checklist_title: AI SEO, AEO, And GEO Checklist
items.item_text: Content distinguishes facts, assumptions, opinions, and product claims.

items.checklist_title: AI SEO, AEO, And GEO Checklist
items.item_text: Pages avoid unsupported superlatives such as "best", "number one", and "guaranteed".

items.checklist_title: AI SEO, AEO, And GEO Checklist
items.item_text: AI-assisted drafts are fact checked and edited by a human with topical knowledge.
